summary: Registered stopwatch action in registry, added UI handler for spawning stopwatches, added timer icon mapping, cleared pycache, restarted server, and verified end-to-end integration with API tests.

verification.notes: Action registered in registry.py, handler added to runAction() in index.html. Timer icon mapped to Lucide 'timer'. API tests: created stopwatch, started, waited 2s, stopped - elapsed_ms=2290. Server restart required pycache clear due to stale .pyc files.

stopwatch_api_endpoints.description: Record a lap time without stopping

frontend_integration.ui_handler: runAction('stopwatch') spawns a new stopwatch via stopwatchManager.spawn()
frontend_integration.highlight_animation: Container pulses briefly when action button clicked
frontend_integration.spawn_button: Floating + button in top-right corner always visible

handoff_notes: Stopwatch feature is fully wired up. The Stopwatch button appears in Tools category. Clicking it spawns a new stopwatch widget and highlights the container. Frontend already has full stopwatchManager implementation (from frontend-dev) with localStorage persistence. Backend has full CRUD API at /api/stopwatches (from backend-dev). All I did was wire them together via registry and action handler. Note: uvicorn --reload did not pick up changes due to pycache issues; required manual pycache clear and server restart.
